title: Effects-and-Lifetimes Calculus — Mechanized Safety Proofs
description: A Rocq (Coq) formalization of a call-by-value calculus with bounded type polymorphism (full F<:), a separate lifetime sort forming a two-point lattice, algebraic data constructors with existential lifetime/type schemas, and algebraic effect handlers with multi-shot resumptions — the proof-side companion of the CoreΔ calculus. The safety story is lifetime-based capability confinement: effect capabilities are local-annotated values, and the lifetime subtyping discipline guarantees that neither a capability nor any local-confined datum can escape the scope that delimits it. The development is axiom-free — every capstone theorem prints «Closed under the global context» under Print Assumptions, enforced by a derived assumption gate (make verify). It includes type soundness, capability confinement at every syntactic occurrence, guarded handler-boundary theorems on states and on labelled transition events with a certified completeness accounting, determinism modulo the fresh-marker choice, certified reflected deciders and a certified evaluator with an OCaml extraction, and a fully verified examples tier with a rejection suite. See README.md for the theorem table and ARTIFACT.md for the build and verification guide.
